(;) The tomb 23' square I.M. is built of rubble and mortar and covered with
a hemispherical fluted dome. It has doorways towards N., S. and E.,
and is coated with plaster. On the west side there is a mihrab recess.
The building is used as a godown. In the centre there are two ruined
masonry graves each measuring some 6' 8" by 4' 5" by 3' 8".
